mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF u
SELECT r.role_id FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.sort_ord,r.role_id
SELECT r.role_nm FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.sort_ord,r.role_id

SELECT m.menu_id,m.scrn_id,m.pc_only_yn,max(a.inq_yn) AS inq_yn, max(a.reg_yn) AS reg_yn,max(a.upd_yn) AS upd_yn,max(a.del_yn) AS del_yn, max(a.upld_yn) AS upld_yn,max(a.dnld_yn) AS dnld_yn,max(a.cnfm_yn) AS cnfm_yn FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN TB_SY_ROLE_MENU_AUTH a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN TB_SY_MENU m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.use_yn='Y' LEFT JOIN TB_SY_MENU g ON g.menu_id=m.upper_menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND m.scrn_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_MENU c WHERE c.upper_menu_id=m.menu_id) GROUP BY m.menu_id,m.scrn_id,m.pc_only_yn,g.sort_ord,g.menu_id,m.sort_ord ORDER BY g.sort_ord NULLS FIRST,g.menu_id,m.sort_ord,m.menu_id
SELECT r.data_scope_cd FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.sort_ord,r.role_id

SELECT s.part_id FROM TB_BS_PART_STD s WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{id} AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM') AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM')) UNION SELECT p.part_id FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND p.hq_yn='Y'
SELECT s.proj_id FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND r.use_yn='Y' AND r.snstv_view_yn='Y')

choose.when: SELECT proj_id FROM TB_BL_BILL WHERE bill_id=#{id}
SELECT b.proj_id FROM TB_BL_RCPT r JOIN TB_BL_BILL b ON b.bill_id=r.bill_id WHERE CAST(r.rcpt_id AS TEXT)=#{id}
SELECT proj_id FROM TB_PJ_ASGN WHERE asgn_id=#{id}
SELECT proj_id FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE WHERE CAST(issue_id AS TEXT)=#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT proj_id FROM TB_PJ_PROJ WHERE proj_id=#{id}

mapper.select: SELECT part_id FROM TB_SL_OPP WHERE opp_id=#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(part_id,'') FROM TB_HR_DEV WHERE dev_id=#{id}
SELECT form_type_cd FROM TB_SY_UPLD WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND reg_user_id=#{userId}
SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_ROLE WHERE use_yn='Y' AND role_id IN #{role}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_USER(user_id,user_nm,email_addr,pwd_hash,temp_pwd_yn,pwd_err_cnt,mfa_err_cnt,user_stat_cd,pwd_chg_dttm,reg_user_id) VALUES (#{id},#{id},concat(#{id},'@example.invalid'),#{hash},'N',0,0,'USE',clock_timestamp(),'SYSTEM') ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET pwd_hash=#{hash},temp_pwd_yn= 'Y''N', pwd_err_cnt=0,mfa_err_cnt=0,mfa_code_hash=NULL,mfa_expr_dttm=NULL, pwd_chg_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{id}, mod_dttm=GREATEST(#{now},COALESCE(mod_dttm,reg_dttm)+INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE user_id=#{id}
